xmldoc.short_description: Add an nflow block library search path.

param_input_item.param_description: a directory that holds one or more library sub-folders, each with a library.json and its native library.

param_output_item.param_description: the updated list of search paths, a cell array of character vectors.

description.p: NFlow.addlibrarypath adds folder to the nflow block library search paths and scans it. Every sub-folder that holds a library.json next to its native library is loaded, so its blocks become available to sim, code generation and the editor without restarting Nelson.
Adding a folder that is already registered has no effect. An error is raised when folder does not exist.

example_item.example_item_description: Build the cumprod example plugin and register its library folder.
